"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"same screen. Every command you run and every turn the AI takes land in one column, in the order they"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"
happened. No chat bubbles."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> The screenshots show the Chinese interface. dshell follows dsh's own language setting
> (**Setting"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s → General → Language**), so every dshell surface is available in English too."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"dshell is a set of plugins for **dsh** (DeepSeek Harness). It does not modify dsh's source: it plugs"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"
into dsh's documented extension points, so dsh stays upgradeable with upstream."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- How it fits together

- Docs for developers"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it fits together"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"dshell is two layers: a **view** you look at, and a **host** that does the work. What you see is
alw"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ays a view of something else — which is why one column can hold your shell output and the AI's
turns"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" at once, and why a session can be pointing at another machine while the window stays here."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Three bands, top to bottom:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **The window** is the browser or the desktop app. It draws one column — your shell's output and
th"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e AI's turns, in the order they happened — and it sends what you type. It holds no state of its
own:"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" everything on screen comes from the host over one websocket.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| What you get | Details |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| A full-bleed terminal | One main shell per session, running real commands — full screen, colours, "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"cursor |
| One merged timeline | Shell output and AI work interleave by time; each AI turn is a coll"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"apsible **task block** |
| Two modes | `$ shell` makes Enter run a command, `✦ agent` makes Enter se"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"nd to the AI — the `$` / `✦` glyph in the input line is the mode, click it to flip |
| The AI's own "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"shell | The AI gets a separate PTY, so it never blocks your foreground program and never steals your"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" terminal |
| Cross-session work | Sessions form **pipes** to delegate tasks to each other and share"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" files by name (the **buffer**) — including across SSH devices |
| Device sessions | Open a session "},{"id":"p16s8","text":"directly on a remote machine: commands, files and the visible terminal all run there |

It is the release that makes a terminal survive a session
switch, tu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rns a WSL2 distribution into a device row, and carries the port forwards that connect

`0.2.1-rc.5`, "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"today's `latest`, included — installs without waiting for a dshell release."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| | What changed | What you notice |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **WSL2 distributions are devices** | A WSL2 distribution on this Windows machine is detected and o"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ffered as a **built-in device row** of its own — open a terminal on it, browse its files, hand it to"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" the AI | There is **no credential to enter** (the distribution is its own credential) and **no port"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" forward** to ask for: WSL2 shares this machine's loopback, so its ports are already reachable here "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"|
| **The 管理台** | dsh's Settings gains a **dshell** section — one page that gathers the whole suite'"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"s settings | **设备与凭据**, **WSL 发行版** and **终端与数据** as three cards on one page, instead of a configure"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" control per plugin row |
| **A ConPTY repaint no longer blanks the terminal** | On Windows, a progr"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"am that repaints its whole screen after a resize — the ConPTY signature — left a **blank wall above "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"the prompt** | The region renders the rows that carry ink and cuts the dead frame around them, so th"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"e row count and the bytes agree again |
| **A session switch keeps its prompt** | Switching to a ses"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"sion and back reset its readiness, so a live device session flashed the first-dial panel over a term"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"inal that was about to work | That the session reached a prompt is remembered for the page's life **"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"and across a reload**, and seeded while the rebind handshake runs |

- **进行中的请求 / 已结束** — every t"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"icket's state, direction, subject and full reply.
- **生效中的授权** — the grants that are live right now,"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" and the real path each one maps."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The screenshot above is a pipe **after** its task settled: the grants have already been reclaimed, s"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"o
